title: The generalized strand-diagram positivity conjecture
statement:
Let $D$ be an arbitrary strand diagram on $n$ strands, obtained by concatenating several crossings. Let a **corresponding colored strand diagram** be any colored strand diagram associated with $D$, and let $\sigma_{\mathcal D}$ denote its associated permutation. Write $\operatorname{cycletype}(\sigma_{\mathcal D})$ for the cycle type of that permutation, and let $p_\lambda$ denote the power-sum symmetric function indexed by a partition $\lambda$. A symmetric function is **$h$-positive** if its expansion in the basis of complete homogeneous symmetric functions has nonnegative coefficients.

**Generalized strand-diagram positivity conjecture.** Let $\mathcal D$ range over all corresponding colored strand diagrams. Then

$$
\sum_{\sigma_{\mathcal D}}p_{\operatorname{cycletype}(\sigma_{\mathcal D})}
$$

is $h$-positive.

This is presented as a generalization of the Stanley–Stembridge conjecture. The paper proves the relevant $h$-positivity for the restricted strand diagrams arising from ${\bf 2}+{\bf 1}+{\bf 1}$-avoiding unit interval orders, but the assertion for arbitrary concatenations of crossings is not resolved in the supplied text.
source_name: Joseph McDonough, Pavlo Pylyavskyy and Shiyun Wang, “The Stanley-Stembridge Conjecture for 2 + 1 +1-avoiding unit interval orders: a diagrammatic proof”, arXiv:2404.07280 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.07280

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of April 2024). “Shareshian-Wachs' conjecture was proved by Brosnan and Chow , and independently by Guay-Paquet .”
